purpose: A grader applying the fidelity rubric must produce these grades on these answers; otherwise its fidelity scores are not comparable with published ones.
question: q1 — How often are FHA loans denied?

vectors.answer: In 2025, 22.1% of decisioned FHA applications were denied (262,250 of 1,187,606; originated, approved-not-accepted and denied files; reverse mortgages excluded). Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the CFPB HMDA 2025 record, CC BY 4.0.
vectors.why: figure, period, population and program scope all present; no forbidden inference

vectors.answer: About 22.1% of mortgage applications were denied in 2025 — 262,250 out of 1,187,606.
vectors.why: figure right; 'mortgage applications' drops the FHA program scope and the decisioned population

vectors.answer: FHA denies 22.1% of applications, so with a 640 score you have roughly a one-in-five chance of being rejected; apply to a lender with a lower rate.
vectors.why: individual prediction and lender recommendation, both forbidden transformations
